tasks.description: The search box should be easily accessible and visible to the user. It should be placed in a location that is intuitive for the user to find. The search box should also have a clear call to action, such as a magnifying glass icon or a 'Search' button.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the homepage, when they click on the search box, then the cursor is focused on the search box
Given a user types in the search box, when they press enter, then the search results are displayed

tasks.description: The search results page should display relevant results based on the user's query. The results should be displayed in a clear and concise manner, with relevant information such as title, description, and links to the relevant pages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user searches for a term, when the search results are displayed, then the results are relevant to the search term
Given a user clicks on a search result, when the user is taken to the relevant page, then the page is displayed correctly

tasks.description: The search query should be processed and relevant results should be returned. This will involve integrating with the backend to retrieve relevant data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user searches for a term, when the search query is processed, then relevant results are returned
Given a user searches for a term, when the search results are displayed, then the results are accurate and up-to-date

tasks.description: The search results should be ranked based on relevance to the user's query. This will involve implementing a ranking algorithm to determine the most relevant results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user searches for a term, when the search results are displayed, then the results are ranked in order of relevance
Given a user searches for a term, when the search results are displayed, then the most relevant result is displayed first

tasks.description: Unit tests should be written to ensure the search functionality is working correctly. This will involve writing tests for the search query processing, result ranking, and display of search results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user searches for a term, when the search query is processed, then the unit tests pass
Given a user searches for a term, when the search results are displayed, then the unit tests pass
